surah.personality_title: Al-Inshiqaq — The Submissive Cosmos & The Inevitable Meeting with the Lord
surah.personality_summary: Cosmic, dutiful, existential, inevitable. Portrays the heavens splitting open and listening in obedient surrender to their Lord, reminding mankind: 'You are laboring toward your Lord with exertion and you will meet Him.' Delineates the joyful reception of the record in the right hand versus the despair of receiving it behind the back.
surah.distinctive_voice: Obedient, existential, transitioning from struggle to reckoning.
surah.opening_ending_dynamic: Connects opening theme to terminal resolution.
surah.overview: Surah Al-Inshiqaaq (The Splitting Open) is the 84th surah in the canonical muṣḥaf sequence, comprising 25 ayat. Classified as Makki.

ayahs.arabic_simple: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ إِذَا السَّمَاءُ انْشَقَّتْ
ayahs.arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم اذا السماء انشقت
ayahs.translation_saheeh: When the sky has split [open]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: When the sky is ripped apart

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: obeying its Lord as it rightly must

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And when the earth has been extended
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: when the earth is levelled out

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And has cast out that within it and relinquished [it]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: casts out its contents, and becomes empty

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: obeying its Lord as it rightly must

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدۡحࣰ ا فَمُلَٰقِيهِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: يَا أَيُّهَا الْإِنْسَانُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًا فَمُلَاقِيهِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: يا ايها الانسان انك كادح الى ربك كدحا فملاقيه
ayahs.translation_saheeh: O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with [great] exertion and will meet it
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: you humans, toiling laboriously towards your Lord, will meet Him

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then as for he who is given his record in his right hand
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: whoever is given his record in his right hand

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَسَوۡفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابࣰ ا يَسِيرࣰ ا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: He will be judged with an easy account
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: will have an easy reckoning

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And return to his people in happiness
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and return to his people well pleased

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهۡرِهِۦ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتَابَهُ وَرَاءَ ظَهْرِهِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: واما من اوتي كتابه وراء ظهره
ayahs.translation_saheeh: But as for he who is given his record behind his back
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: but whoever is given his record from behind his back

ayahs.translation_saheeh: He will cry out for destruction
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: will cry out for destruction––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And [enter to] burn in a Blaze
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: he will burn in the blazing Fire

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, he had [once] been among his people in happiness
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He used to live among his people well pleased

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, he had thought he would never return [to Allah]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He thought he would never return [to his Lord]––

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: بَلَىٰٓۚ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرࣰ ا
ayahs.arabic_simple: بَلَىٰ إِنَّ رَبَّهُ كَانَ بِهِ بَصِيرًا
ayahs.arabic_clean: بلى ان ربه كان به بصيرا
ayahs.translation_saheeh: But yes! Indeed, his Lord was ever of him, Seeing
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: indeed he will! His Lord was watching him

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So I swear by the twilight glow
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: I swear by the glow of sunset

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And [by] the night and what it envelops
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: by the night and what it covers

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And [by] the moon when it becomes full
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: by the full moon

ayahs.translation_saheeh: [That] you will surely experience state after state
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: you will progress from stage to stage

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So what is [the matter] with them [that] they do not believe
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: So why do they not believe

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانُ لَا يَسۡجُدُونَۤ۩
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِمُ الْقُرْآنُ لَا يَسْجُدُونَ ۩
ayahs.arabic_clean: واذا قرئ عليهم القران لا يسجدون ۩
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And when the Qur'an is recited to them, they do not prostrate [to Allah]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Why, when the Quran is read to them, do they not prostrate themselves [to God]

ayahs.translation_saheeh: But those who have disbelieved deny
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: No! The disbelievers reject the Quran––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And Allah is most knowing of what they keep within themselves
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: God knows best what they keep hidden inside––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So give them tidings of a painful punishment
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: so give them news of a painful torment

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمۡ أَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُونِۭ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِلَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: الا الذين امنوا وعملوا الصالحات لهم اجر غير ممنون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds. For them is a reward uninterrupted
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: But those who believe and do good deeds will have a never-ending reward
